metadata.title: आदिवासी आजीविका: ज़मीन का मालिक भूखा क्यों है | Tribal Livelihood: why adivasi faces hunger
metadata.description: In this episode we will look into one of the aspects that is livelihood. we will see what tribals used to do traditionally, also we will have a look into what is the status of land ownership among tribals and in that we will also look how these lands are distributed. Also, we will try to understand what are the assets adivasis have? and are these a sign of their development? and does actually they have enjoyed any development in their socio-economic status.
